comment: Triage vocabulary for issues. scripts/ci/sync_labels.py applies this to the repository; docs/triage.md says what each label means and which rule assigns it. Labels not listed here are left alone, so CI plumbing labels are safe.

labels.name: S1: critical
labels.description: Data loss, a build that will not start, or a security exposure

labels.name: S2: major
labels.description: A crash, hang, lost state, broken connection, or a regression on a path people use

labels.name: S3: minor
labels.description: Wrong behavior with a workaround

labels.name: S4: cosmetic
labels.description: Wording or appearance, with no effect on what cmux does

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Auto-triage could not pick an area; a person decides

labels.name: area: terminal
labels.description: Ghostty surface, rendering, scrollback, escape sequences, fonts

labels.name: area: input
labels.description: Keyboard, shortcuts, IME, mouse, clipboard and paste

labels.name: area: layout
labels.description: Splits, panes, tabs, windows, resizing, full screen

labels.name: area: sidebar
labels.description: The workspace sidebar: list, groups, status, reordering

labels.name: area: workspaces
labels.description: Workspaces, sessions, restore after relaunch, worktrees

labels.name: area: agents
labels.description: Agent integrations (Claude Code, Codex, ACP), agent chat, hooks, status

labels.name: area: cloud
labels.description: Cloud machines and workspaces, relay transport

labels.name: area: remote
labels.description: cmux ssh, remote daemon, tunnels, device pairing

labels.name: area: ios
labels.description: The iOS app and mobile clients

labels.name: area: cli
labels.description: The cmux CLI, cmux-tui, the socket API and SDKs

labels.name: area: settings
labels.description: Settings UI and the config file

labels.name: area: browser
labels.description: The embedded browser, web surfaces, inline VS Code

labels.name: area: command-palette
labels.description: Command palette, quick open, find

labels.name: area: appearance
labels.description: Themes, light and dark mode, window chrome

labels.name: area: notifications
labels.description: Notifications, banners, badges, the bell

labels.name: area: updates
labels.description: Install, Homebrew, updates, nightly and release builds, signing

labels.name: area: auth
labels.description: Sign-in, accounts, teams, billing

labels.name: area: performance
labels.description: Latency, CPU, memory, launch time

labels.name: area: localization
labels.description: Translations and internationalization

labels.name: area: accessibility
labels.description: VoiceOver, the accessibility API, reduced motion, focus order

labels.name: area: docs
labels.description: README, docs pages, the site, contributor guides

labels.name: area: build-and-ci
labels.description: Build system, CI workflows, test infrastructure

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small and self-contained, with a pointer to the code. Read docs/triage.md first

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Nobody on the team is working on this and we would take a patch
